shared_elements: schematic figures worked onto an unprepared natural rock surface
curvilinear outlined motifs without interior modelling
justification: Both surfaces bear schematic, outline-drawn motifs applied to bare natural rock, but that is a generic correspondence rather than a shared iconography. A shows an unmistakable long boat with a row of crew strokes, a hooked prow-head, a quadruped and human legs, while B's boulders carry indistinct curvilinear relief motifs (apparently face- or figure-like) with no vessel, no crew row and no comparable grouping of subjects.
